_readme: Per-Justice voice profiles for sts. Each entry maps a Justice to a Kokoro base voice (for gender/prosody) and a Speech Accent Archive (SAA) reference clip (for OpenVoice ToneColorConverter accent conversion). See LICENSE.md for full attribution and licensing terms for the SAA clips. These are accent approximations from anonymous SAA volunteers, not recordings or clones of the Justices themselves.

roberts.formative_region: Long Beach / La Porte County, Indiana
roberts.caveat: Closest available northern-Indiana match; Roberts grew up in La Porte County, not Fort Wayne.
roberts.saa_search_note: 2026-08-04: SAA speaker(s) for roberts chosen by an empirical search (distance/saa_search.py) over 29 regionally/sex-plausible SAA candidates, scored against roberts's real aggregated acoustic profile from 10 Oyez oral arguments from the 2025 term (see distance/build_real_profiles.py). Winner: english524 (distance 17.0%, vs. 26.4% for the prior pick).
roberts.recalibration_note: 2026-08-05: recalibrated against "prepared remarks" register (YouTube lecture/speech, see distance/lecture_voice_profiles.json) instead of oral-argument Q&A, since sts reads written opinions aloud -- a much more formal register than courtroom banter. kokoro_speed retuned with a verify-and-correct methodology (distance/tune_rate.py) after the previous linear-extrapolation approach was found to fail on long documents (Alito regression). Added pitch_nudge_semitones (-0.80 st) and tilt_correction_db_per_oct (-0.85 dB/oct) as new post-processing corrections (distance/measure_baseline.py) applied after OpenVoice conversion, closing residual gaps the SAA-speaker/base-voice search couldn't reach.

thomas.caveat: WEAKEST MATCH: SAA has no coastal-Georgia/Savannah speaker. Hazlehurst (south GA) is the closest geographic proxy available. Deliberately NOT attempting a Gullah accent: Thomas's adult public speech is standard Southern-inflected American English, not Gullah, so a Gullah imitation would be inaccurate rather than merely unavailable.

kavanaugh.recalibration_note: 2026-08-05: recalibrated against "prepared remarks" register (YouTube lecture/speech, see distance/lecture_voice_profiles.json) instead of oral-argument Q&A, since sts reads written opinions aloud -- a much more formal register than courtroom banter. kokoro_speed retuned with a verify-and-correct methodology (distance/tune_rate.py) after the previous linear-extrapolation approach was found to fail on long documents (Alito regression). barrett.tuning_note: kokoro_base_voice and kokoro_speed picked 2026-08-03 by an empirical search over stock af_* Kokoro voices (see distance/tune_profile.py), minimizing distance to Justice Barrett's real measured pitch/F1/F2/tilt/rate from Oyez oral-argument audio in Berk v. Choy. af_kore only marginally beat the prior af_sarah (36.5% vs 37.4% combined distance) -- F2 in particular stayed ~950-1000 Hz across every candidate voice, well below the real ~2055 Hz, suggesting the SAA reference clip itself is the bottleneck, not the base voice choice.
